name: Tilt Gravity
description: Tilt your phone to steer the falling marbles in the funnel.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to release marbles like usual. While they bounce through the funnel, tilt your phone left or right to pull them that way — the entire level's gravity follows your tilt. On desktop, hold the left/right arrow keys to simulate tilt. A tilt indicator in the top-left shows the current direction and strength.
